jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst, AI and Data
jobs.description: As a Technical Business Analyst, you'll play a key role in shaping and delivering complex data transformation initiatives across large-scale enterprise environments. Working at the intersection of business, data and architecture, you'll help define how data is sourced, structured and consumed, translating fragmented data landscapes into clear, scalable solutions. You'll partner with business stakeholders, data product teams and platform SMEs to understand data lineage, ownership and dependencies across upstream and downstream systems. From discovery through to solution design, you'll contribute to defining data acquisition, migration approaches and ongoing operating models that enable high-quality, trusted data outcomes.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, 2026 Graduate Australia & New Zealand
jobs.description: You will help strategize measurement, collecting data, and generating insights. This work will help understand and improve product experience and engagement, improve efficiency and costs, and guide strategy. You'll report to a Data Engineering Manager, and learn from your team mentor who are some of the best Data Engineers in the business. You must be currently enrolled in a Bachelors or Masters program in Software Engineering, Computer Science or other related technical program, with experience programming with Python or other object-oriented programming languages, knowledge of data structures, proficiency in SQL and relational databases experience, and demonstrated interest in the Data Engineering field through academic coursework, previous work or internship experience, or personal projects.

jobs.title: AI Native Platform Engineer
jobs.description: As a junior member of the AI SDLC Developer Productivity and Enablement team, you will help build and maintain the SCM, CI/CD pipelines, and developer productivity tooling that engineering teams rely on daily. You will contribute to maintaining the organisation's GitHub Actions runner fleet, developing reusable workflows, and ensuring internal integrations work seamlessly for business application teams. Collaborating closely with development teams, you will identify pain points in their delivery processes, help design customised automation where it adds value, and contribute to embedding agentic engineering principles into the organisation's developer workflows. Demonstrated ability and enthusiasm for agentic engineering using tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot with proper engineering discipline, awareness of source control management practices, developer workflow integrations, and observability and logging tools such as Grafana and Splunk.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Platforms Engineer
jobs.description: As a Machine Learning Platform Engineer, you'll take end-to-end ownership of your product in a modern DevOps culture, and be responsible for architecture, design, development, testing and operations and deliver incrementally in iterative cycles. You will work in a multi-disciplinary team alongside data scientists to build ML powered solutions for clients as well as implement MLOps to streamline the model experimentation and ML tooling and workflows for Data Scientists. Demonstrated proficiency using cloud technologies and integrating with ML services including GCP Vertex AI, DataRobot or AWS SageMaker in large and complex organisations is required, along with experience with SQL and Python environments. Data engineering experience will be highly regarded, as well as previous experience and familiarity with cloud technologies and architectural practices to enhance tooling across the ML model development lifecycle.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Commercial Performance
jobs.description: You will be working on some of the largest tooling solutions that Canva has within its data science specialty and will make key technical contributions to a large code base and develop net new methodology to improve coverage, accuracy and interpretability. Canva's flagship campus is in Sydney, and you have choice in where and how you work—Canva trusts employees to choose the balance that empowers them and their team to achieve their goals. Data Scientists are embedded within every major area of Canva—product, business, and operations.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern (Computer Science), Summer 2026/2027
jobs.description: As a Machine Learning Engineer intern, you'll report to a manager in Core Machine Learning within the broader Analytics group. The team pursues opportunities that produce revenue or MAU improvements, partnering across the company to scale insights into automated ML solutions with strong velocity from ideation to output. Build machine learning and predictive models to solve product and growth problems. Able to commit to a 12-week full-time (40hrs/week) program from November 2026 - February 2027. Currently enrolled full-time in a degree program (Master's preferred) and returning to the program after the completion of the internship, graduating by January 2028. Experience writing software in Python, Scala, or Spark; experience with SQL is a plus. Applications will be accepted from Australian and New Zealand Citizens and Australian Permanent Residents.
